text:
Rosa: Opened a tiny PR adding an 'egress & HAProxy troubleshooting' appendix to private-deploy.md. Contains quick tcp egress checks, kube curl pattern, HAProxy log grep, and a dev SDK TLS-fallback snippet. Need quick review + link sanity.
Ken: Paste snippets here so reviewers can copy-paste. Also call out HSM vendor port (16963) and suggest tcpdump when TLS fails.
Rosa: Snippets:
```bash
# test TCP egress to HSM appliance
nc -vz 10.2.4.11 16963 || echo "egress blocked"

# pod-based health check (no jumpbox)
kubectl run --rm -it --image=curlimages/curl probe -- sh -c 'curl -sS http://10.0.9.2:8080/health'
```
Omar: Add HAProxy grep example and a restart line for cert swaps.
Rosa: Added:
```bash
# haproxy log sample / grep
grep "backend/" /var/log/haproxy.log | tail -n 60
# restart after cert update
sudo systemctl restart haproxy && sudo journalctl -u haproxy -n 80 --no-pager
```
Ken: CI link-check flagged a broken reference to /docs/private/network/ports.md. Update to /docs/networking/ports-reference.md.
docs-bot: Link check: PR #512 contains 1 broken link -> /docs/private/network/ports.md (404).
Rosa: Fixed link and added a short note on asymmetric SNAT differences between clouds. Pushed fixup.
Omar: LGTM. I'll do a quick proofread and merge if CI is green.
Ken: Approved.
